signature.name: VTask.compLinearMap
signature.type: {R : Type uR} -> {ι : Type uι} -> {M₁ : ι → Type v₁} -> {M₁' : ι → Type v₁'} -> {M₂ : Type v₂} -> [Semiring R] -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (M₁ i)] -> [Module R M₂] -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M₁' i)] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (M₁' i)] -> (g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) -> (f : (i : ι) → M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) -> MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total and imposes no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for all valid multilinear maps g and families of linear maps f.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (ι : Type*) (M₁ M₁' : ι → Type*) (M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [∀ i, Module R (M₁ i)] [Module R M₂] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁' i)] [∀ i, Module R (M₁' i)] (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) (hf : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (f i)), Function.Injective (fun g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂ => VTask.compLinearMap g f)

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (ι : Type*) (M₁ M₁' : ι → Type*) (M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [∀ i, Module R (M₁ i)] [Module R M₂] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁' i)] [∀ i, Module R (M₁' i)] (g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) (f : ∀ i, M₁ i ≃ₗ[R] M₁' i), VTask.compLinearMap g (fun i => (f i : M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i)) = 0 ↔ g = 0

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (ι : Type*) (M₁ M₁' : ι → Type*) (M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [∀ i, Module R (M₁ i)] [Module R M₂] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁' i)] [∀ i, Module R (M₁' i)] (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) (hf : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (f i)) (g₁ g₂ : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂), VTask.compLinearMap g₁ f = VTask.compLinearMap g₂ f ↔ g₁ = g₂
